evidence: Films were analyzed by X-ray diffraction/reflection (XRD/XRR), field emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM), time-of-flight elastic recoil detection analysis (TOF-ERDA), and UV-vis spectrophotometer. Film thicknesses, densities, and crystal structures were evaluated from XRR and grazing incidence (GI) XRD patterns. Film morphology was studied by a Hitachi S4800 FESEM. Composition and impurity levels of the films were analyzed by TOF-ERDA. Thicknesses and refractive indices of the CaF2 thin films were determined from reflection (or transmission) spectra. The permittivities of the films were measured using a HP 4284A precision LCR-meter at 10 kHz.
